description.value: You grant the subject’s awareness to extend a fraction of a second into the future, allowing them to better evade an opponent’s blows. The subject gains a +1 insight bonus to AC and on all saving throws. If caught in a situation where their Dexterity bonus isn’t applied to their Armor Class, this bonus to AC and saving throws does not apply.
